bug_semantics: x0vncserver's live MIT-SHM framebuffer path called shmget(IPC_PRIVATE, size, IPC_CREAT|0777). IPC_PRIVATE selects a new SysV IPC key; it does not override the segment's mode bits. The 0777 mode therefore allowed unrelated local users to attach to the live capture buffer for reading or writing. They could observe screen pixels, alter pixels sent to the VNC client, or corrupt the buffer at a sensitive time and crash x0vncserver. Changing the mode to 0600 restricts attachment to the creating user.
flaw_origin: The repository-tracked flaw first appears in 47ed8d321c32c6b741cff1f4ff686165c4f269f4, the 2004-10-08 SVN 'Initial revision': x0vncserver/Image.cxx:104-107 creates the framebuffer segment with IPC_CREAT|0777. Its direct parent 266bb36cd47555280fffd3aab1ed86683e26d748 has an empty tree. The later x0vncserver refresh d31fd31a96e494f8abc97500cc6ebcad7afe68af and directory migration b30ae7facbdf8273f34f5d67d3d2e9c81db75576 preserved the same permission mistake and are not the origin.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object identifies author Constantin Kaplinsky <const@tightvnc.com> and committer Constantin Kaplinsky, with authored/committed time 2004-10-08T09:43:57Z. Its complete message is `Initial revision\n\ngit-svn-id: svn://svn.code.sf.net/p/tigervnc/code/trunk@2 3789f03b-4d11-0410-bbf8-ca57d06f2519`; it has no Co-Authored-By trailer, no Generated-with trailer, no AI/bot identity, and no AI-attribution marker.
evidence: First-party report and runtime reachability: https://github.com/TigerVNC/tigervnc/issues/2079 documents ImageFactory -> XPixelBuffer -> ShmImage::Init, a real RFB handshake, and resulting live framebuffer SysV segments with mode 777; the local source has UseSHM enabled by default in unix/x0vncserver/XDesktop.cxx:68-69, constructs ImageFactory/XPixelBuffer at lines 261-268, and unix/x0vncserver/Image.cxx:344-353 selects ShmImage when available.

BIC source and history: https://github.com/TigerVNC/tigervnc/blob/47ed8d321c32c6b741cff1f4ff686165c4f269f4/x0vncserver/Image.cxx#L104-L107 contains shmget(..., IPC_CREAT|0777). The BIC page https://github.com/TigerVNC/tigervnc/commit/47ed8d321c32c6b741cff1f4ff686165c4f269f4 identifies parent 266bb36cd47555280fffd3aab1ed86683e26d748. The parent commit https://github.com/TigerVNC/tigervnc/commit/266bb36cd47555280fffd3aab1ed86683e26d748 reports zero files, its tree https://github.com/TigerVNC/tigervnc/tree/266bb36cd47555280fffd3aab1ed86683e26d748 is empty, and the parent raw path returns 404, directly proving that x0vncserver/Image.cxx and the vulnerable line are absent in the immediate parent.

Non-origin lifecycle commits: https://github.com/TigerVNC/tigervnc/commit/d31fd31a96e494f8abc97500cc6ebcad7afe68af refreshed x0vncserver from tightvnc-unix while retaining 0777; https://github.com/TigerVNC/tigervnc/commit/b30ae7facbdf8273f34f5d67d3d2e9c81db75576 migrated the source to unix/x0vncserver/Image.cxx while retaining 0777. These are later refresh/move commits, not the first parent-absent introduction.

Direct fix: https://github.com/TigerVNC/tigervnc/commit/0b5cab169d847789efa54459a87659d3fd484393 is a one-file, one-line security change in unix/x0vncserver/Image.cxx:269-272 from IPC_CREAT|0777 to IPC_CREAT|0600. Its message explicitly states that other users could observe the screen, modify client output, or crash x0vncserver. The maintainer also confirmed 'Fixed on master in 0b5cab169' in issue #2079.

Affected/fixed boundary: NVD states 'TigerVNC before 1.16.2' at https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-34352. The clone's packed refs resolve v1.16.1 to 10b17f402c3519ed3a135187f319b473c20ba9f0 and v1.16.2 to b555312d70d7ff017f866649a7e7167af4eb8fca. v1.16.1 still has 0777 at https://github.com/TigerVNC/tigervnc/blob/v1.16.1/unix/x0vncserver/Image.cxx#L269-L272, while v1.16.2 has 0600 at https://github.com/TigerVNC/tigervnc/blob/v1.16.2/unix/x0vncserver/Image.cxx#L269-L272. The v1.16.2 release page https://github.com/TigerVNC/tigervnc/releases/tag/v1.16.2 says v1.16.1 accidentally omitted the security fix, making 1.16.2 the first fixed release. The early v0.0.90 tag already contains 0777 at unix/x0vncserver/Image.cxx:258-261, consistent with the BIC predating the released affected range.

Advisory/fix references: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4vj5-vh2w-8g5j, https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-34352, and the project's 1.16.2 announcement https://groups.google.com/g/tigervnc-announce/c/anHL9WLshLI all point to the same permission flaw and fixed release.
reasoning: The vulnerability is on the active server capture path rather than dead or viewer-only code: XDesktop enables MIT-SHM by default, creates an ImageFactory and XPixelBuffer, and ShmImage::Init allocates the pixels backing the live screen image. History across both pre-migration x0vncserver/Image.cxx and current unix/x0vncserver/Image.cxx leads to the initial SVN revision 47ed8d321c32c6b741cff1f4ff686165c4f269f4. That commit contains the 0777 allocation, whereas its immediate parent is an empty repository, so it is the smallest repository commit that introduces the vulnerable implementation. Later source refresh and path migration commits only preserve it. The one-line direct fix 0b5cab169d847789efa54459a87659d3fd484393 changes 0777 to 0600. The v1.16.1 tag still contains 0777 because that release omitted the intended security patch; v1.16.2 contains 0600 and is the first fixed release, matching the advisory's before-1.16.2 boundary. BIC-only attribution finds a conventional human-authored 2004 SVN-import commit object and no AI marker or trailer, so the causal verdict is NOT_AI.
